probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Newport Homeowners Association Overview Announcements Documents Board Events About Buy Newport Newport Homeowners Association Overview Announcements Documents Board Events About Buy Newport Last updated on March 2025 update Landscaping Schedule Update Revised mowing and trimming schedule to reduce noise impact. Our landscaping vendor is adjusting the weekly schedule to minimize noise during early mornings. Effective March 18: Monday: Front entrances, clubhouse grounds, pool perimeter. Tuesday: Building clusters A to C and adjacent common areas. Wednesday: Building clusters D to F, detention basin, and trail edges. Please keep gates unlocked on your scheduled day so crews can access fenced areas that require mowing. Report missed areas to the management office within 24 hours.
